'''Mistress Hornwell''' is the caretaker, with her husband [[Master Hornwell]], of one of [[Elayne Trakand]]'s estates in [[Andor]].{{ref|{{twotc|Mistress Hornwell}}|comp}}

==Appearance==
Mistress Hornwell resembles her husband remarkably, though she is slightly less round and slightly less gray than he is.{{ref/book|8|20}}

==History==
Mistress Hornwell and her husband keep one of Hoouse Trakand's Andoran estates.{{ref||comp}}

After Elayne's party escapes the [[Kin]]'s [[Farm]] near [[Ebou Dar]], [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] leads the group toward the Hornwells' manor house while Elayne remains behind to unweave the gateway and prevent the [[Seanchan]] from learning [[Traveling].{{ref/book|8|6}}


==Activities==
When Elayne's party reaches the estate, Mistress Hornwell and Master Hornwell have the estate's workers, [[Pol]], and the servants from the [[Tarasin Palace]] helping to find sleeping accommodations for more than two hundred unexpected arrivals. The work proceeds surprisingly quickly, though [[Alise Tenjile]] proves even more effective at bringing the disorder under control than the capable Hornwells.{{ref/book|8|20}}

The manor shelters Elayne's party overnight before they continue toward [[Caemlyn]] the next morning.{{ref/book|8|20}}
